title: Venue recording: was the camera clock right?
brief: An 18-minute phone video filmed indoors at a hackathon venue on Sunday 8 November 2026. The file says it started at 11:42:37 UTC. Independently establish when it was really recorded, without trusting the file's clock.

claim.description: File metadata says recording started 2026-11-08 11:42:37 UTC (UK time = UTC in November).

evidence.label: Venue video A001_11081142_C004 (phone, ceiling lights, people talking)
